METALWORK — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: METALWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Centre La, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Centre La.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Centre La.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Centre La.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Centre La.

2. When learning Metalwork related businesses, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metalwork related businesses.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metalwork related businesses.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metalwork related businesses.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Metalwork related businesses.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

4. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Run with the tool

5. When learning Gas Welding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Gas Welding.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Gas Welding.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Gas Welding.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Gas Welding.

6. When learning Career Opportunities in Metalwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.

   D. Skip safety briefings for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.

7. When learning Forging, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Forging.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Forging.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Forging.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Forging.

8. When learning Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.

9. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. International Cricket Team

10. When learning Assembly Drawings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly Drawings.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly Drawings.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly Drawings.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Assembly Drawings.

11. When learning Heat treatment of steel, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Heat treatment of steel.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Heat treatment of steel.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Heat treatment of steel.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Heat treatment of steel.

12. When learning Project 2, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 2.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 2.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project 2.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Project 2.

13. When learning Surface Finishing Processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Surface Finishing Processes.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Surface Finishing Processes.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Surface Finishing Processes.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Surface Finishing Processes.

14. When learning Project 1, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 1.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project 1.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Project 1.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 1.

15. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Forging and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
